en.title: Toroczkai PM Hopes Dim Amid Orbán Strength
en.summary: The probability of László Toroczkai becoming Hungary's next Prime Minister fell by 1.4% to 1%. This decline is driven by recent headlines highlighting strong international endorsements for current PM Viktor Orbán, including 'total endorsement' from Donald Trump, reinforcing Orbán's grip on power.
drivers: Trump's 'total endorsement' of Orbán
Orbán's strong international far-right support
Orbán's continued political dominance
en.why_matters: The market's low probability for Toroczkai reflects the perceived stability of Orbán's leadership, indicating a likely continuation of his conservative and Russia-friendly policies.

zh.title: 托罗茨凯总理希望渺茫，欧尔班地位稳固
zh.summary: 拉斯洛·托罗茨凯成为匈牙利下任总理的概率下降1.4%至1%。这一跌幅主要受近期头条新闻影响，这些新闻强调现任总理维克托·欧尔班获得包括唐纳德·特朗普在内的国际强力支持，巩固了他的执政地位。
drivers: 特朗普“全面支持”欧尔班
欧尔班获国际右翼力挺
欧尔班政治主导地位稳固
zh.why_matters: 市场对托罗茨凯的低概率反映了欧尔班领导层的稳定，预示其保守且亲俄政策将持续。
